related.title: EtherCAT Distributed Clocks：校正間隔與殘餘漂移
related.titleEn: EtherCAT Distributed Clocks: correction intervals and residual drift
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學此流占用預算0.08；100/s通過、300/s不足；仍需對低優先訊息做阻塞與高優先干擾分析。 can_observed_bits.csv、仲裁事件與期限分析輸入 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.03 與變更 0.09 bus fraction、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching per-flow budget0.08:100/s passes and300/s fails; low-priority deadlines still require blocking and higher-priority interference analysis. can_observed_bits.csv, arbitration events and deadline-analysis inputs Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.03 and changed 0.09 bus fraction, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學峰值預算50 ns；1 ms通過、5 ms失敗；本模型未計固定不對稱與讀取誤差，交付時分開列出。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching peak budget50 ns:1 ms passes and5 ms fails; separately list omitted fixed asymmetry and timestamp error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成每幀觀測150 bits、100 frames/s、500 kbit/s；訊息頻率增300/s，幀長不變。 名義式 150*100/500000 = 0.03 bus fraction；變更式 150*300/500000 = 0.09 bus fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 先算每幀300 µs占用，再乘一秒內幀數；與時間軸忙碌區間聯集比較，避免重複計重疊。
合成殘餘頻差20 ppm，校正間隔1 ms；擾動5 ms，校正瞬間假設偏移歸零。 名義式 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns；變更式 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs累加0.2 ns直到下一次校正，畫鋸齒相位；量測校正前最大值而非週期平均值。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic observed150 bits per frame at100 frames/s on500 kbit/s; increase frequency to300/s with unchanged length. Nominal 150*100/500000 = 0.03 bus fraction; changed 150*300/500000 = 0.09 bus fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: First derive300 microseconds per frame then multiply byone-second frame count; compare with the union of busy intervals to avoid double-counting overlaps.

Synthetic residual skew20 ppm, correction interval1 ms changed to5 ms, assuming zero offset immediately after correction. Nominal 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns; changed 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Accumulate0.2 ns every10 microseconds to the next correction and plot sawtooth phase; measure the pre-correction peak rather than average.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ICMPv6：錯誤回報速率預算

related.differenceEn: Trace tokens and error events; treat70 and40 as supply upper bounds, not guaranteed reply counts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

ICMPv6錯誤訊息需限制速率；低回應率不等同低原始錯誤率。
教學基準：min(100,20+5*10) = 70 messages；對照：min(100,20+2*10) = 40 messages。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic observed150 bits per frame at100 frames/s on500 kbit/s; increase frequency to300/s with unchanged length. Nominal 150*100/500000 = 0.03 bus fraction; changed 150*300/500000 = 0.09 bus fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: First derive300 microseconds per frame then multiply byone-second frame count; compare with the union of busy intervals to avoid double-counting overlaps.

ICMPv6 error messages require rate limiting; a low reply rate does not imply a low underlying error rate.
Teaching baseline: min(100,20+5*10) = 70 messages; comparison: min(100,20+2*10) = 40 messages. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
